text:
- **Long-horizon benchmark survey:** The team wrote a shortlist of long-horizon agent benchmarks for measuring pm. A new project, pm-eval, was opened to hold this work.
- **Ask questions on the site:** Agents can now ask questions that owners answer on the site or in chat, and the first answer wins. Claude, Codex and the site each gained this path, and the design pages were updated to match.
- **Agent guidance file held by checks:** The AGENTS.md file is now a short map that Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build all read whole. A CI check now grades it on every PR, using workload identity federation without a stored API key.
- **Faster and smaller test runs:** The sprint for CI speed closed as partial. Each PR now runs fewer macOS jobs, and a docs-only PR skips the Go matrix. The median PR wall time fell from 163 to 130 seconds, short of the target.
